title: parodia tabularis subsp. bommeljei
intro: Parodia tabularis subsp. bommeljei, commonly known as Bomel's ball cactus, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. It is a rare and endangered cactus native to Argentina, characterized by its unique and globular shape. The plant is valued for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Bomel's ball cactus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
